value.rationale: Random reshuffling versus replacement is a central numerical linear-algebra sampling choice. The theorem determines the exact dimension boundary of universal one-epoch Euclidean mean-square dominance and exhibits the reversal at the minimal dimension, with opposite objective-energy ordering on the same natural SPD instance. This matters for accurately interpreting iterate-distance guarantees rather than assuming energy-risk comparisons transfer across metrics; it is not a mere normalization or arbitrarily selected tabulation.
